text: Each plan's build and draft removes its own Go build cache once it ends, whatever its outcome, after every check, repair, fallback and review that uses it, and keeps the rest of its run directory (#366). The cache stays the run's own, so no build reads what another's sandbox wrote. A watcher's first act, before it starts a step, also removes the caches runs in its work directory left, as it clears the clone's worktrees, since that directory is its own and no run there is live then; it spares any run one of its steps is in, and follows no link. On @gitdek's machine, 176 caches the factory never removed had grown to 32 GB.
